svg.title: Free Telegram Proxy
svg.desc: Free Telegram Proxy: 18 stars. An MTProto proxy index. A proxy is published only after it relays a real request to a Telegram datacenter and returns our nonce, in all three rounds. Last funnel: 3,431 collected, 3,159 DNS resolved, 2,311 TCP open, 1,981 reached a Telegram DC, 1,974 verified 3 / 3.
